    "Chief complaint: Soreness and cracked skin on fingers/hands (mainly palms)",

    "   - Severity: Now painful, interfering with work/ADLs",

    "Medications/allergies: Metformin; no allergies",

    "   - Family: Diabetes (no known skin conditions, asthma, or bowel problems in family)",

    "   - Non-smoker; minimal alcohol (couple of pints/week)",
    "Vital signs/exam findings: None mentioned",
    "Labs/imaging: None mentioned"
  ],
  "step2_vindicate": {
    "V": [
      "Peripheral vascular disease: Diabetes can predispose, but no evidence of color changes, ulceration, or pulses loss."
    ],
    "I": [
      "Contact dermatitis (irritant/contact): Supported by occupational exposure to cleaning chemicals, cracked/itchy hands, and effect on palms.",
      "Eczema (atopic/contact): History of dry skin elsewhere, pruritic, and cracked lesions.",
      "Fungal infection (tinea manuum): Chronic hand rash possible, but classic features (annular, central clearing, scaling, involvement of one hand) not described."
    ],
    "N": [
      "Cutaneous malignancy (very unlikely): No nodules, ulcerations, or chronic non-healing lesions described."
    ],
    "D": [
      "Diabetic-related skin changes (xerosis): Diabetes can cause increased dryness/pruritus, but lacks inflammation described here.",
      "Vitamin deficiency (e.g., B3/niacin—pellagra): Unlikely without other systemic findings (glossitis, diarrhea, dementia)."
    ],
    "I2": [
      "Iatrogenic: No new medications; metformin rarely associated with skin reactions.",
      "Intoxication: No mention of exposure to toxins beyond cleaning chemicals."
    ],
    "C": [
      "Congenital ichthyosis: No childhood history or generalized involvement—unlikely."
    ],
    "A": [
      "Allergic contact dermatitis: Could be allergy to products, but more likely irritant given chronicity and occupation.",
      "Autoimmune (e.g., psoriasis): Palmar psoriasis possible with fissuring, but no clear evidence of plaques/silvery scale/history."
    ],
    "T": [
      "Trauma: Chronic mechanical trauma possible (hands at work), but pattern and chronicity fit irritant dermatitis more."
    ],
    "E": [
      "Hypothyroidism: Can cause dryness, but no systemic features or exam findings.",
      "Diabetic-related skin changes/Xerosis: As above under D."

    },

      "supporting_evidence": [
        "Chronic hand involvement"
